verdict.line: You lose if Renekton snowballs a solo kill before level 6; you win the 56.2% matchup (436 games) by surviving his Fury spikes and out-scaling him with health stacking.

brief.thesis: Renekton holds lane and solo-kill advantage because his Fury bar turns his W into a triple-slash 1.5s stun and his E into an armor-shredding dash once he's above 50 Fury — but none of that scales, while Mundo's max-health Q poke and regen do. Stay out of his W (300 range) and E (450 range) windows early and this flips hard by the 11-15 mark.

theirWindow.what: His W (Ruthless Predator) becomes a 1.5s triple-stun that destroys shields and his E gains bonus damage plus Armor reduction. Do not contest melee trades here — stay at Q range and let him burn Fury on minions.

yourWindow.when: His E (Slice and Dice) just went on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no gap-closer for 16 down to 10 seconds depending on rank. Step in, pop E (Masochism) for the missing-health AD boost, and trade — he can't escape or re-engage until it's back.

powerCurve.note: W stun lands before your E/W are ranked up
50+ Fury empowers W and E, enables solo kills
Q poke range and passive regen stabilize the lane
Health-stacking items outscale his Fury burst
Near-unkillable; he has no late-game reset

start.why: Mitigates his auto-attack harass and the Q poke he throws while farming Fury, which is where most of his early lane pressure comes from.

boots.why: Lets you reposition out of his 300-range W and 450-range E threat windows instead of getting caught standing in them.

core.why: First in the 65.2% win-rate path (46 games) — stacks health passively while you're farming safely at Q range.
Converts the health you're stacking into regen, which is exactly what outlasts his all-in Fury windows.
Scales your Q damage off max health and gives you the wave-clear to shove him off plates once lane stabilizes.

situational.when: he's snowballing kills and his 50+ Fury Q heal is keeping him topped off in trades
he or his team builds into crit or lifesteal to try to out-damage your sustain
you need more healing amp on your passive and R for extended skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the passive trading pattern this matchup demands — poke with Q, soak autos, heal back up, repeat without ever needing to stand in his stun range.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport runs the highest win rate of the three common pages (59.8% over Ghost+Teleport's 51.9%) — Flash is the better dodge tool against his W stun chain, and Teleport lets you reset after Q-poking a wave instead of staying in his threat range to last-hit.

playing.title: Poke, don't melee
playing.detail: Farm with Q (Infected Cleaver, 975 range) and avoid trading inside his W (300 range) or E (450 range) — his damage output there is designed to punish exactly that.

playing.title: Track the Fury threshold
playing.detail: At 50+ Fury his W becomes a triple-slash 1.5s stun that shreds shields and his E gets bonus damage and Armor reduction. Disengage around levels 3-6 when he's near that number.

playing.title: Use W to cut his stun
playing.detail: Burning Agony reduces the duration of any disable on you, including his W stun — have it active before he commits to an engage, not after.

playing.title: Punish dead E cooldown
playing.detail: Slice and Dice is down for 16 to 10 seconds depending on rank. Once he's used it to engage or farm, that's your window to step in with E (Masochism)'s AD boost.

playing.title: Save R for sustain, not panic
playing.detail: Sadism's value is the extended health regen and movement speed over its 75s cooldown — use it to win a skirmish that's dragging on, not as a reflex button.

playing.title: Play the long game
playing.detail: He holds lane and solo-kill advantage early; your job is to not die to a Fury spike before 6. The 56.2% win rate over 436 games is earned in the mid-to-late game, not lane phase.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning — Fury thresholds, cooldown windows, and trade timing — is my own read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not stand in range of Renekton’s (E)! Use [Q] to farm lane to avoid being punished. You will have the advantage as the game progresses!
